title: Melville Research Bench
description: A research bench for reading, annotating and comparing Herman Melville's Billy Budd and his short tales in their versions: the manuscript's states of revision, the editions made from it, and the magazine and book texts of the tales. A research project of David M. Berry and Michael Jonik (University of Sussex), built on bench-kit. The texts are read at runtime from the Melville Electronic Library's TEI (github.com/performant-software/mel-website); none of MEL's transcription or encoding is included in this record. The manuscript is in the Houghton Library, Harvard University, MS Am 188 (363).
